component.i18n.summary: A headless language service, ICU formatting, and ready-made switchers.

home.demo.title: Try the Select component
home.demo.text: Search and choose an option with the real Rivinia component. Keyboard behavior and selection state come from the package itself.
home.select.label: Choose a quality
home.select.hint: Open the menu to try the real component.
home.pillars.title: Four principles. One developer experience.
home.pillars.text: Select a principle to see how it guides Rivinia.
home.pillar.simplicity.title: Simplicity
home.pillar.simplicity.text: Clear APIs and focused packages make the first useful step easy to find.
home.pillar.flexibility.title: Flexibility
home.pillar.flexibility.text: Use ready-made UI or compose headless behavior with your own presentation.
home.pillar.performance.title: Performance
home.pillar.performance.text: Small packages and focused entry points help keep applications intentional.
home.pillar.accessibility.title: Accessibility
home.pillar.accessibility.text: Semantic patterns, keyboard support, and accessible states are part of the design.
docs.startTitle: Choose the package for your task.
docs.startText: Rivinia is published as focused Angular packages. Browse the package list to choose the capability you need, then follow its package documentation and examples.
docs.installText: For example, install the Select package when your application needs a ready-made or headless selection pattern.
docs.installFollowup: Import only the entry point you use. The package page links to the available UI and headless APIs.
docs.continueTitle: Go directly to the area you need.
docs.playgroundText: Visit the current Playground page and its available examples.
